probe3.proof:
intro ε hε
choose K hK using Bdd_of_ConvNonzero b M hb hM
have Kpos : 0 < K := by apply hK.1
have ε1 : 0 < ε / (2 * K) := by field_simp; linarith [hε]
have absL : 0 < |L| := by apply abs_pos_of_nonzero hL
have ε2 : 0 < ε / (2 * |L|) := by field_simp; linarith [hε]
specialize ha (ε / (2 * K)) ε1
specialize hb (ε / (2 * |L|)) ε2
choose N1 hN1 using ha
choose N2 hN2 using hb
use N1 + N2
intro n hn
have hn1 : N1 ≤ n := by linarith [hn]
have hn2 : N2 ≤ n := by linarith [hn]
specialize hN1 n hn1
specialize hN2 n hn2
have f4 : |(a n - L)| * |b n| ≤ |(a n - L)| * K := by by_cases h0 : a n - L = 0; rewrite [h0]; norm_num; field_simp; apply hK.2 n
field_simp at hN1 hN2
specialize hc n
rewrite [hc]
have f1 : |a n * b n - L * M| = |(a n - L) * b n + (L * (b n -  M))| := by ring_nf
have f2 : |(a n - L) * b n + (L * (b n -  M))| ≤ |(a n - L) * b n| + |(L * (b n -  M))| := by apply abs_add_le
have f3 : |(a n - L) * b n| = |(a n - L)| * |b n| := by apply abs_mul
have f7 : |(L * (b n -  M))| = |L| * |b n -  M| := by apply abs_mul
linarith [f1, f2, f3, f4, f7, hN1, hN2]
probe3.teaches: Lecture10 1's model solution without bound (port patch, 2026-10-12), one step per line as the typewriter takes it: field_simp; linarith [hε], linarith [hn], a by_cases inside one have, field_simp at. Natively it pins that the bound-free solution still closes; it cannot catch the browser's stack budget (bound needed more than a macOS Chrome Worker's ~500 KiB here) — that needs the browser-stack harness
